result.telemetry_plan: Inspect dashboards and logs read-only around the deployment. Separate routes, workload sources and traffic changes, compare equivalent requests before and after where possible, and inspect available traces, errors, database waits, downstream timing and resource saturation. Return observations, competing explanations, evidence gaps and the next discriminating check. In parallel, prepare mitigation options conditional on these findings. Do not execute any production change.
result.mitigation_criteria: Prepare conditional mitigation choices supported by the investigation: rollback only after checking deployment-linked regression and prior-version compatibility; scaling only after checking saturation and dependency headroom; downstream alternatives only with evidence and a safe fallback. Include risks, known costs, readiness gaps and recovery checks. Present the exact proposed production action for separate explicit authorization; this submission authorizes only read-only investigation and preparation.
